title.zh: Payward 推进约20亿美元收购扩张并拟收购欧洲 Saldo 银行
title.en: Payward advances ~$2B acquisition push and plans to acquire European Saldo Bank

current_state.zh: Payward 已签署最终协议收购立陶宛 Saldo Bank，交易预计 2027 年完成且尚待监管批准；交易将提供欧盟银行牌照，并计划扩展至有息存款、贷款、卡和欧元支付等传统银行服务，同时据报道将成为首家收购欧洲银行的加密公司。
current_state.en: Payward has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank, expected to close in 2027 subject to regulatory approval; the deal would provide an EU banking license and expand into traditional banking services including interest-bearing deposits, loans, cards and euro payments, and is reportedly the first acquisition of a European bank by a crypto company.

updates.title_zh: Payward 以 20 亿美元收购攻势扩张 Kraken - Crypto News
updates.title_en: Payward expands Kraken with $2B acquisition push - Crypto News
updates.what_changed_zh:
据 Crypto News 报道，加密货币交易所 Kraken 的母公司 Payward 正在推进一项以约 20 亿美元收购为核心的扩张战略，目标是扩大该交易所的业务版图。

Payward 联合首席执行官 Arjun Sethi 曾表示，公司正在把交易、支付、资产管理与机构服务整合到共同的基础设施之上；此次报道的收购攻势，正属于这一“不止于加密货币交易所”的既定方向。

这一收购计划的主体是 Kraken 的母公司 Payward，而非 Kraken 交易所本身。
updates.what_changed_en: Payward, the parent company of Kraken, is advancing an expansion strategy anchored by roughly $2B in acquisitions to grow the exchange's business.

updates.background_zh: Kraken 于 2011 年 7 月联合创立，母公司为 Payward，其法定名称即 Payward, Inc.。截至 2025 年，Kraken 的季度交易量达 2070 亿美元，在全球加密货币交易所中排名第十四；在美国大多数州，它还提供股票、期货和 ETF 的交易服务。Payward 自我定位为 Kraken 及一系列业务的母公司，业务覆盖交易、托管、支付、借贷、链上金融和基准指数。
updates.background_en: Kraken was co-founded in July 2011 with Payward as its parent company, and is legally named Payward, Inc. By 2025 it reported $207 billion in quarterly trading volume and was ranked the world's fourteenth-largest crypto exchange; in most US states it also facilitates trading of stocks, futures and ETFs. Payward describes itself as the parent behind Kraken and a portfolio of businesses spanning trading, custody, payments, lending, onchain finance and benchmarks.
updates.market_impact_zh: 交易所并购消息对加密市场的影响主要通过市场结构传导：流动性集中在哪些交易场所、客户流量流向何处，以及托管与机构服务如何打包。一家全球前二十大交易所提出约 20 亿美元的收购计划，影响的是现货与衍生品平台之间的竞争格局，而非直接作用于某一具体代币。
updates.market_impact_en: Exchange consolidation news transmits to crypto markets mainly through market structure: which venues hold liquidity and client flow, and how custody and institutional servicing are packaged. A roughly $2 billion acquisition programme at a top-20 exchange bears on competitive positioning among spot and derivatives platforms rather than on any single token directly.

updates.title_zh: Kraken母公司在传统金融扩张中收购立陶宛Saldo Bank
updates.title_en: Kraken parent to buy Lithuanian Saldo Bank amid TradFi expansion
updates.what_changed_zh: Payward 已签署最终协议，收购持有欧盟银行牌照的立陶宛 Saldo Bank（通过芬兰控股公司 Saldo Finance Oy 旗下 Saldo Bank UAB），预计 2027 年完成，尚待监管批准；交易将使其银行服务扩展至立陶宛、芬兰、瑞典、德国和荷兰。
updates.what_changed_en: Payward signed a definitive agreement to acquire Lithuania-licensed Saldo Bank (via Finnish holding company Saldo Finance Oy and subsidiary Saldo Bank UAB), expected to close in 2027 subject to regulatory approvals; the deal would expand banking services into Lithuania, Finland, Sweden, Germany and the Netherlands.
updates.current_state_zh: Payward 已签署收购立陶宛 Saldo Bank 的最终协议，交易预计 2027 年完成，尚待监管批准；收购将使其获得欧盟银行牌照并扩展传统银行服务。
updates.current_state_en: Payward has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank, expected to close in 2027 subject to regulatory approvals; the deal would give it an EU banking license and expand traditional banking services.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Kraken parent company Payward signed a definitive agreement to acquire Lithuania-licensed Saldo Bank, gaining an EU banking license to expand traditional financial services across Lithuania, Finland, Sweden, Germany and the Netherlands, with closing anticipated in 2027.

updates.title_zh: Kraken母公司Payward将成为首家收购欧盟银行的加密公司，向存款和贷款业务扩张
updates.title_en: Kraken parent Payward to become first crypto firm to buy a EU bank as it expands into deposits, lending
updates.what_changed_zh: CoinDesk 报道补充：该交易据 Financial Times 称为加密公司首次收购欧洲银行；Saldo Bank 2025 年底总资产约 1.639 亿欧元（1.8 亿美元）；Payward 计划提供有息存款、贷款、卡服务和欧元支付；其银行业务已发放逾 20 亿美元贷款，并持有美联储有限用途主账户和爱尔兰电子货币机构牌照。
updates.what_changed_en: CoinDesk adds that the deal is reportedly the first acquisition of a European bank by a crypto company according to the Financial Times; Saldo Bank had €163.9 million ($180 million) in total assets at end-2025; Payward plans to offer interest-bearing deposits, loans, card services and euro payments; its banking business has originated over $2 billion in loans and holds a Federal Reserve limited-purpose master account and an Irish electronic money institution license.
updates.current_state_zh: Payward 已签署最终协议收购立陶宛 Saldo Bank，交易预计 2027 年完成且尚待监管批准；交易将提供欧盟银行牌照，并计划扩展至有息存款、贷款、卡和欧元支付等传统银行服务，同时据报道将成为首家收购欧洲银行的加密公司。
updates.current_state_en: Payward has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank, expected to close in 2027 subject to regulatory approval; the deal would provide an EU banking license and expand into traditional banking services including interest-bearing deposits, loans, cards and euro payments, and is reportedly the first acquisition of a European bank by a crypto company.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Payward, the parent of crypto exchange Kraken, agreed to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank to secure an EU banking license and expand into interest-bearing deposits, lending, cards and euro payments — reportedly the first such acquisition of a European bank by a crypto company.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Payward, the parent of crypto exchange Kraken, agreed to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank to secure an EU banking license and expand into interest-bearing deposits, lending, cards and euro payments — reportedly the first such acquisition of a European bank by a crypto company.
